disclaimer: General wellness information, not medical advice.
goal: Move from processed food toward a Mediterranean pattern, starting at the slow end: first make regular eating a habit (the user tends to skip meals and undereat).

steps.title: Eat a planned breakfast every day
steps.cue: Right after you make your morning coffee (or tea), before opening email or heading out.
steps.action: Eat one breakfast from the list below, or the breakfast in this week's mealPlan — any one is fine. On field days, take a packable one with you if you're leaving early.
steps.successLooksLike: Breakfast logged on at least 5 of 7 days this week.
steps.why: Regular planned meals help an undereater reach energy and protein needs (DGA 2025-2030: protein at every meal, 1.2-1.6 g/kg/day ≈ 110-145 g/day). Breakfast skipping is associated with worse cardiometabolic markers (AHA 2017; observational). Linking a new behavior to a fixed daily cue and repeating it is the core method of habit formation (Gardner 2012, narrative review).
steps.evidenceNote: Benefits of breakfast per se are observational; cue-based habit formation comes from a narrative review of behavioral research. Rated 'limited' honestly — the step is low-risk and targets the user's own problem (skipping meals).
